name: backlog-groom
description: Read the open backlog and the code, report what needs refinement, what belongs under a common parent, what is duplicated, stale, missing, or out of order — then have an independent session re-check every claim before it reaches the report.

stages.description: Observe the board. Cannot score itself: its schema has no verdict and no confidence field.
Independent pass. Sees the findings' claims and the same backlog, but not the groomer's argument for them.
